name: Dify
summary: Open-source platform for building agentic workflows and LLM apps.
description: Dify is a platform to build AI agents, RAG knowledge pipelines and LLM workflows on a visual canvas, then deploy them as apps or APIs. It is open source and can run on Dify Cloud, in a private VPC or self-hosted, which makes it popular with technical teams. A free plan is available on the cloud, with paid plans for more message credits and team members.

pricing.label: Freemium
